title: Crush (Tsukuyomi)
body:
Syntax: crush

Description: Tsukuyomi caster action, usable only while you and your target are inside its shared illusion. Deals 80-120 Health damage and has a 25% chance to end the ordeal early; advances it by one action otherwise. The ordeal ends when its hidden action limit is reached.

Date: 2026-09-27
